## What and why

One milestone or fix. Link the spec section it changes and explain the decisions.

## How it was checked

- [ ] Plan agreed before implementation
- [ ] `pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm knip && pnpm test:coverage`
- [ ] `pnpm test:e2e` (UI or scene changes)
- [ ] Checked in the browser on desktop and at 375 px (UI or scene changes)
- [ ] `docs/spec.md` / `docs/architecture.md` updated if behaviour or structure changed
